sources.title: Seedance 2.5 AI Video Generator — Up to 30s Video With Audio
sources.snippet: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's video-and-audio model, released July 31, 2026. Generate videos up to 30 seconds from text, images, and references, with synchronized audio. Available modes, resolution, and price are shown before you generate.

sources.title: Seedance 2.5 AI — AI Video Generator
sources.snippet: Seedance 2.5 AI turns text, photos, and multimodal references into watermark-free 480p, 720p or 1080p video with clips from 4 to 30 seconds.
